Players Committee card image of [[Lor San Tekka (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “If you just deployed BB-8 or a Resistance leader to same or related location, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. During your control phase, one of your other Resistance characters present may make a regular move.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/lorsantekka_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/bf1d08e0b82f40b5422be00dcc4c3a781c1dbefd bf1d08e] (14 July 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
